summary: Full-stack testing of new features: AI chat streaming, plan generation, emergency workout, plan activate, league invite codes + join-by-code, workout/complete streak logic + streak_at_risk, professional assessment gate, splash screen, share achievement PNG, and profile modal. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (new suite). Frontend: 15/15 Playwright checks passed end-to-end against the preview URL with real IA responses. All critical flows are wired correctly to the backend.

minor.issue: Still not idempotent: if the user clicks 'Finalizar Treino' twice on same day, streak stays at 1 (good) but workouts_this_week, calories_week, challenges progress and total_workouts all keep incrementing. Consider gating by last_workout_date == today.
No cap on how many AI plans a user can accumulate. Each call inserts a new plan doc — over time /api/workout/plans grows unbounded. Consider archiving old ai=true plans.
Code is 6 hex chars uppercase (uuid4 slice). No expiry, no rotation endpoint. Acceptable for MVP but flag for future.
system_message includes raw history via string interpolation; long histories could blow past model context. The endpoint already truncates to last 10 messages though.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal cannot be closed via Escape key (only via X icon or clicking backdrop). Minor UX inconsistency but not blocking.
KCAL is rendered as '-480' (red negative) which reads like a subtraction; should be '+480 kcal' or '480 kcal queimadas'.

action_items: Consider making POST /api/workout/complete idempotent per day to prevent inflating weekly stats/challenges on double-clicks.
Add Escape-key handler to close Profile edit modal (and Leagues invite modal) for consistency.
Change kcal rendering in workout completion card to positive/neutral color.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~780 lines — same suggestion as iteration 1: split into modules (auth, workout, leagues, ai_coach, assessment, seeding).

POST /api/leagues/join-by-code awaits join_league(lg['id'], user) but join_league is a FastAPI route function — it works because it's a plain async fn returning dict, however it's fragile. Extract shared logic into an internal helper.
generate_plan parses JSON from LLM output with .split('```') — brittle; consider a proper markdown code-fence stripper or ask the model for structured output via 'response_format=json'.
chat_endpoint saves the user message BEFORE streaming, so if the client aborts we still store an orphan user turn. Acceptable, just be aware.
test_credentials: No app credentials — sessions seeded directly into MongoDB (users + user_sessions) and cookie 'session_token' injected into Playwright context. All test users cleaned up after runs (prefix fe_test_ and test_new_).
seed_data_creation: Helper /app/tests/seed_frontend_user.py creates fully-seeded users with sessions. Cleaned after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest suites exist and can be re-run as regression: test_auth_and_isolation.py (23 tests) and test_new_features.py (10 tests). Both self-clean via module-scope fixtures. For Playwright, use /app/tests/seed_frontend_user.py to create users then inject cookie 'session_token' on the preview domain. Splash timeout is 1.8s. lg1 invite code is persistent per league — once generated it stays; test cleanup does NOT reset lg1.invite_code.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocker bugs. Two low-severity UX issues reported (Escape key on modals, negative kcal rendering).
